tooling.steps: Run the focused repository tests and review changed files; record command, exit result and coverage limits.

installation.steps: Verify targeted before/after captures, expected source/config changes, compilation and applicable repeat/recovery checks. Investigate every unexpected delta.

startup.steps: Start fresh Play through normal startup. Inspect ServerBase/ClientBase StartupState and new console output. Use the actual Play UI; confirm StartScreenActive is false, visible controls accept input and no competing owners start.

garage.steps: From normal interactive play enter dealership, preview paint, return to hub and exit. Open owned appearance, browse modules and back out: unbought previews/temporary overrides clear. Drive in, customise/back, exit and re-enter: camera/session/preview ownership releases correctly. Record each tested input and visible result.

race.steps: From normal interactive play spawn, exit/re-enter vehicle, stage/cancel a race, then drive and finish a selected event. Record route, event, expected result, actual result and console window. API staging alone is not a driven finish.

errors.steps: Capture console before/after the affected normal flow with session/time markers. Exercise the relevant invalid input, cancellation or unavailable dependency only in an approved isolated/no-save environment. Record busy-state release, retry and recovery. Separate known errors by issue ID; do not call an error-free API response a clean console.

cleanup.steps: In the same build/session take warm-up, settled baseline and equal repeated-flow checkpoints (for example 0/5/10/15/20 cycles). Record vehicle/preview/instance counts, detached instances, connections when observable and settled/peak resources. Reuse runtime_sample.lua for bounded samples. Trace continued growth; flat parented counts alone do not prove bounded retention.

api.steps: Verify no-save sandbox before invoking mutating test APIs. Use the existing bounded API helper only with its stated prerequisites and stop on a failed action. Record results as API-only, even if all calls succeed.

streaming.steps: Drive the same World route at speed, stream out/re-enter, teleport to the selected race and respawn. Check missing visuals, collisions, attachments and cleanup at named checkpoints. Preserve WIP areas and physical assets.

device.steps: Run the selected flow on a physical target device. Record model, OS, Roblox build, graphics, input, thermal/battery state, route, cache, duration and samples. An emulator or Studio window proves layout only. iPhone 7 remains the selected baseline until deliberately changed.

multiplayer.steps: Use an isolated published test place with the planned active player count and duration. Record actual count, activity, session/build, latency, route and errors; for the performance acceptance target use 15 active players and 30 minutes. One Studio client cannot satisfy this gate.

persistence.steps: Use an authorised isolated published test place and test accounts. Test save/rejoin, failed load, retries, overlapping ownership/contention and shutdown against explicit expected invariants. Record test dataset and recovery. Never infer saved-data acceptance from the Studio no-save sandbox.
